postings.title: Senior Mask Design Engineer - Hardware
top_requirements: Design and layout of high‑speed mixed‑signal mask layers for advanced CMOS processes.
Perform full‑chip DRC/LVS sign‑off and ensure compliance with mask‑level design rules.
Collaborate with circuit designers to translate RF and analog schematics into manufacturable mask data.
postings.summary: The role focuses on creating mask layouts for high‑speed mixed‑signal circuits at NVIDIA, matching the candidate's mixed‑signal and RF background. It offers senior‑level compensation and hands‑on layout work.

postings.title: Senior Analog Layout Engineer
top_requirements: Independently execute full‑stack analog and mixed‑signal layout from floorplan to final verification.
Optimize layout for performance metrics such as noise, gain, and matching while meeting area constraints.
Coordinate with circuit designers to resolve layout‑related design issues and ensure sign‑off.
postings.summary: Senior Analog Layout Engineer role at IntelliPro requires deep analog/mixed‑signal layout expertise, aligning with the candidate's circuit design experience. Compensation meets the target range.

postings.title: Senior / Staff Engineer – SerDes Analog/Mixed-Signal Design
top_requirements: Design high‑performance SerDes analog front‑ends (CTLE, VCO, PLL) for AI accelerator ASICs.
Perform RF system simulations (noise, linearity, jitter) and silicon bring‑up across multiple process nodes.
Lead cross‑functional block integration and debug of mixed‑signal IP in high‑speed I/O stacks.
postings.summary: Senior/Staff Engineer at Upscale focuses on SerDes analog/mixed‑signal design, directly matching the candidate's RF and high‑speed communications background with senior compensation.

postings.title: Analog Mixed Signal Design Engineer
top_requirements: Design low‑power, high‑performance analog and mixed‑signal blocks for data‑center storage ASICs.
Perform full‑chip simulation and layout verification to meet stringent power‑budget targets.
Collaborate with digital teams to integrate mixed‑signal IP into system‑level designs.
postings.summary: Broadcom analog mixed‑signal design role in Singapore provides hands‑on circuit work that aligns with the candidate's mixed‑signal expertise, though compensation is lower than target.

postings.title: SG Analog/Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
top_requirements: Develop verification testbenches for mixed‑signal ICs using SystemVerilog/UVM.
Create coverage models and execute functional, performance, and corner‑case tests on analog blocks.
Analyze verification results and provide detailed feedback to design engineers for silicon fixes.
postings.summary: Tetramem verification engineer role focuses on mixed‑signal test development, matching the candidate's validation background, though pay may be below the $200K target.

postings.title: Senior Hardware Engineer, Read Channel Systems
top_requirements: Integrate read‑channel ASICs into magnetic recording systems and perform high‑speed signal integrity testing.
Develop validation experiments to characterize analog front‑end performance (noise, gain, jitter).
Collaborate with mechanical and firmware teams to optimize system‑level read/write reliability.
postings.summary: Senior hardware engineer at Seagate works on read‑channel mixed‑signal ASICs, a good fit for the candidate's RF and system integration experience, though compensation is modest.
